shortDescription: Module for setup of PKIProfile Avi RESTful Object

options.name: allow_pki_errors
options.description: Exempt errors during certificate verification. Enum options - ALLOW_EXPIRED_CRL, ALLOW_ALL_ERRORS. Field introduced in 30.1.1. Maximum of 1 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: ca_certs
options.description: List of certificate authorities (root and intermediate) trusted that is used for certificate validation. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: created_by
options.description: Creator name. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: crl_check
options.description: When enabled, avi will verify via crl checks that certificates in the trust chain have not been revoked. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: crl_file_refs
options.description: Refers to fileobject containing crl body. It is a reference to an object of type fileobject. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ignore_peer_chain
options.description: When enabled, avi will not trust intermediate and root certs presented by a client. Instead, only the chain certs configured in the certificate authority section will be used to verify trust of the clients cert. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- true), basic (allowed values- true) edition. Special default for essentials edition is true, basic edition is true, enterprise edition is false. Default value when not spe

options.name: is_federated
options.description: This field describes the objects replication scope. If the field is set to false, then the object is visible within the controller-cluster and its associated service-engines. If the field is set to true, then the object is replicated across the federation. Field introduced in 17.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: markers
options.description: List of labels to be used for granular rbac. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the pki profile. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: validate_only_leaf_crl
options.description: When enabled, avi will only validate the revocation status of the leaf certificate using crl. To enable validation for the entire chain, disable this option and provide all the relevant crls. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- true), basic (allowed values- true) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.
